title: In properties dialog for item in the desktop:// IO worker, "Location" field inaccurately shows "/ (desktop)" instead of correct path
line: The Properties dialog of an item on the desktop now shows its real folder, like /home/user/Desktop, instead of "/ (desktop)".
explanation: KFilePropsPlugin built the Location field from the item's URL, so for desktop:/TestFolder it took the virtual path "/" and appended the scheme, giving "/ (desktop)". The desktop worker already maps its items to local files (UDS_LOCAL_PATH), but that was only used for the mount point and content type. Now the Location uses the folder of the item's local path when there is one (also when several items are selected), without the scheme suffix; trash:/ keeps its current display, since its local path is the internal Trash folder.

commits.message:
KPropertiesDialog: show the real location of items on desktop:/

Items in desktop:/ had their Location shown as "/ (desktop)", the path
of the virtual URL, even though the worker maps them to local files. Use
the local folder instead when the item has one, except for the trash.

BUG: 412670
